name: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Our client is a global software company transforming the way engineering and manufacturing organizations develop and manage complex products. Their platform enables some of the world’s leading manufacturers to accelerate innovation, improve collaboration, and optimize product lifecycle management.


We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer reporting to the Manager of Cloud Services Operations to provide excellent solutions for the security, availability, performance, efficiency, change management, and monitoring of the service. In this role, you will work with a world-class engineering team to drive excellent customer experiences with our SaaS offering, deploy services across multiple cloud environments, and implement automation to continuously reduce toil for customer operations.


Key takeaways:

Role & Domain: Site Reliability Engineer, SRE, Cloud Computing, SaaS, Enterprise, PLM / Digital Thread

Methodology & Tools: Microsoft Azure, Docker, K8S, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Packer, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Sentinel, Git, .NET Core, PowerShell

Salary: Up to 22 500 PLN gross on Perm Contract, up to 27 000 PLN net on B2B

Working model: 100% remote (or from the office Cracow/Warsaw).

Location: Krakow, ul. Fabryczna

Recruitment process:

  1. A call with Motife recruiter - 30 min
  2. A call with the hiring manager - 1h
  3. Technical online interview - 1h
  4. HR interview - 1h

Responsibilities:

  • Create and maintain customer cloud environments for operating the PLM Platform.
  • Work closely with DevOps, support, and development teams.
  • Work with cutting-edge technology in the cloud (Azure preferred).
  • Implement automation to continuously reduce toil for Customer operations using CI/CD processes.
  • Be part of a team that introduces new technologies and deploys services to multiple cloud environments and regions.
  • Solve technical problems, guide various teams (internal & external), and continually improve our systems, deployments, operations, monitoring, and overall cloud activities and costs.
  • Provide technical expertise and ownership in the diagnosis and remediation of security and privacy issues of the Managed Services offerings, including internal and external technical communication.
  • Set up cross-region environments using automated or manual procedures.
  • Respond to customer support issues related to these environments.
  • Maintain industry knowledge of the latest trends, technology, and practices.
  • Participate in on-call shifts as required.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field required.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience working in cloud computing, virtualization, and containers – Docker and K8S.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with a desire to take on responsibility.
  • Advanced networking knowledge - Load balancers, Firewalls, VPNs, TCP/IP - troubleshooting, performance tuning.
  • Monitoring systems and SLA tracking.
  • Hands-on experience administering and supporting high-scale Production workloads.
  • Positive attitude and a strong commitment to delivering quality work.
  • Additional languages are desirable.
  • Must be eligible to work in Poland


What do we offer:

  • UoP or B2B Contract.
  • Medical Package with Medicover.
  • Life insurance with Warta.
  • MyBenefit Cafeteria with MultiSport Cards.
  • Provision of high-quality work equipment, including a laptop and phone.
